Chapter 615: Chapter 38 The Value Of The Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 615: Chapter 38 The Value of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

No one wished to stay close to an existence that could kill them at any moment—it was far too risky.

Moreover, for those special Ninth Rank Evolvers who had lived until now, each had reaped a significant bounty, and in the eyes of the Galaxy Master, they were no different from moving lands of opportunity.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan, satisfied, absorbed the Origin Clock into his body, continuing to nurture it with the power of the world.

“Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter…” Lin Yuan’s smile faded as he planned to upload the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter first.

...

This too was something that needed to be done each time he traversed, constantly updating the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path to attract more Evolvers to cultivate and provide assistance for the future Ultimate Leap.

Of course, harvesting a huge amount of Merit Points as well as vast wealth was also considered an additional gain.

Uploading the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path to the Goddess of Wisdom didn’t mean selling the rights to this evolutionary path; Lin Yuan remained the founder of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.

For every sale of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path, Lin Yuan would receive thirty percent of the profits.

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan directly connected to the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Ninth Rank Evolver, Galaxy Master Scholar Lin Yuan, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you…”

A solemn and cool voice sounded almost instantly in Lin Yuan’s ear.

“I wish to upload the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter,” Lin Yuan said.

Immediately, he uploaded all the contents of the thoroughly arranged Ninth Rank Chapter.

Beyond this, Lin Yuan also uploaded the path of bloodline cultivation he had summarized himself as a branch of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.

“Respected Ninth Rank Evolver, Galaxy Master Scholar Lin Yuan, please wait a moment, the Ninth Rank Chapter and Bloodline Cultivation Path you have uploaded are currently being evaluated…”

After the Goddess of Wisdom spoke, she fell silent.

Lin Yuan expected this and patiently began to wait.

…

In the depths of the Virtual World.

A Mysterious Space.

Nine majestic thrones stood tall.

Just then, several figures appeared out of thin air.

Xia Qin Supreme Being.

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being.

Ancient Power Supreme Being.

Void God Supreme Being.

In total, four Evolver Tower Masters descended in consciousness.

“Goddess of Wisdom, what matter did you have to call us here for?”

The Void God Supreme Being slightly furrowed his brow; as the ultimate of the Void Evolution Path, he spent most of his time merging into the vast and endless Origin Source of space.

It took a great effort for him to come out this time, only to be summoned by the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Void God, don’t be so hot-tempered; the Goddesses also act in the interest of human civilization,” said the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

The nine Supreme Beings of human civilization had diverse characters; the Ancient Power Supreme Being was decisive and ruthless against different species, preferring to err on the side of killing rather than forgiving, but he was quite gentle towards his own kind.

“Four Supreme Beings, the Ninth Rank Chapter of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path needs your evaluation,” the Goddess of Wisdom’s voice came through at that moment.

“The Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter? Is it the evolutionary path created by that strongest genius in the history of human civilization?” the Void God Supreme Being’s eyes slightly lit up.

“Yes.”

“This youngster is growing too fast; he was just in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm killing Hunyi of the Tianyu Clan and has opened up at least one billion Spatial Layers.”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being spoke with a hint of surprise in his voice.

As a Supreme Being, capable of going against the current to witness the past of the Cosmic Starry Sky, and observing various unimaginable geniuses, he was still astonished by Lin Yuan.

One billion Spatial Layers? Even with the help of time treasures, opening up so many layers would be as difficult as reaching the skies.

None of the progenies raised by the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization, despite the pouring of various resources, managed to open up beyond one billion Spatial Layers at the Ninth Rank.

“Indeed, such a genius, never heard of, nor even spoken of before,” Ancient Power Supreme Being was also somewhat amazed, and upon confirming Lin Yuan was human, he felt somewhat relieved.

“Hopefully, this youngster can make it to the end,” sighed Xia Qin Supreme Being.

To make it to the end meant stepping into Tier 12, becoming the Ultimate of an Evolution Path, ranking as the tenth Supreme Being of human civilization.

“Okay.”

“Goddess of Wisdom, please show us the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.” Void God Supreme Being was also intrigued.

Especially after seeing the assessment of Lin Yuan by the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being and the other two Supreme Beings, his curiosity was piqued even more.

Especially Xia Qin Supreme Being, he actually hoped that the young one could make it to the end? The Void God Ultimate Being was keenly aware of the hardships involved in becoming a Supreme Being.

It had practically nothing to do with talent. How many among those who reached the Tier 11 Peak lacked talent or qualifications?

It mainly depended on the accumulation in all aspects and that bit of luck.

No Tier 11 Peak Evolver was certain of their success before attempting to become a Supreme Being.

“Four Supreme Beings, please look,” the Goddess of Wisdom sent the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and the bloodline cultivation path separately to the four Supreme Beings.

With the computational power of the three Goddesses, even the Ninth Stage Evolution Path could be judged independently, without the need to inform the several Supreme Beings.

But the potential of the Martial Tao evolutionary path was too significant. Relying only on computational power might result in omissions, so the input of the Supreme Beings was still needed.

This would allow for a more accurate determination of the potential of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

Before long,

the Supreme Beings had generally finished reviewing it.

“Interesting, this Ninth Rank Chapter actually involves the transformation of the Inner World? I can deduce that the transformed Inner World will indeed be much more stable,” one commented.

“Truly marvelous, such a direction for transformation has never been seen in the Cosmic Starry Skies before. How did this young one come up with it?” another marveled.

“Rare indeed, the Ninth Stage Martial Tao… Future Ninth Stage Martial Tao Evolvers will be significantly stronger than other strong beings at the same level,” added another.

The four Supreme Beings quietly discussed. They naturally could see through the exquisite details of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and possessed a stable and perfected method of world transformation.

World transformation? Was it that easy to achieve? A stable world, every part formed a perfect balance. Minor changes might even lead to the collapse of the entire world.

“And this bloodline cultivation path, it’s several tiers more mature than those currently in our Human Civilization’s bloodline evolution families…”

The Void God Ultimate Being looked over the bloodline cultivation path and gave his evaluation.

“Indeed so,” he concurred.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path, even if it doesn’t transform into the Supreme Evolution Path in the future, is definitely a foundation-level evolutionary path for our Human Civilization…”

“Our Human Civilization really struck a treasure this time.”

…

The four Supreme Beings looked at each other and smiles appeared on their faces.

“Four Supreme Beings, regarding the final determination of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter, valued at eighty million Merit Points, and the bloodline cultivation path, valued at fifty million Merit Points, are there any objections?”

The Goddess of Wisdom spoke.

“Eighty million Merit Points seems a bit low, round it off to one hundred million,” one suggested.

“And that bloodline cultivation path, although it’s best suited for the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, other Evolvers can also benefit from it to some extent. Let’s also set it at one hundred million,” Xia Qin Supreme Being mused and said.

“We have the same opinion,” concurred the Ancient Power Supreme Being and the other two Supreme Beings.

In reality, the three Goddesses had many grounds for their final determination, neither too much nor too little.

But the four Supreme Beings felt that, facing a peerless genius like Lin Yuan, why not grant more Merit Points? After all, the Human Civilization Alliance was vast and prosperous. What benefited Lin Yuan also benefited Human Civilization.

“Determination approved,” replied the Goddess of Wisdom.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was meditating with his eyes closed.

“Respected Ninth Rank Evolver and Galaxy Master Lin Yuan Scholar, the evaluation of your submitted Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter and bloodline cultivation path has been completed…”

The solemn and cold voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“It’s done?” Lin Yuan opened his eyes and kept listening.

“After evaluation, the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter is valued at one hundred million Merit Points, the bloodline cultivation path at one hundred million Merit Points, totaling two hundred million Merit Points. Would you like to receive them now?”

The Goddess of Wisdom asked quickly.

“Two hundred million Merit Points?” Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

What is the most precious in the Human Civilization Alliance? Civilization coins? Cosmic coins? Cosmic Crystals? Numerous secret treasures?

None of these.

The most precious thing in Human Civilization is Merit Points.

Lin Yuan had not understood this before, but after spending time at the Eternal Spring, he came to appreciate the value of Merit Points.

Let’s say this, Human Civilization has many strategic treasures that are not open to the public. Those different species, even if they offered a great price, couldn’t obtain them.

But as long as you are a human, if your authority meets the requirements, you can acquire them through Merit Points.

In Human Civilization, Merit Points can achieve anything, and that is no empty talk.

Even if you need to pay enough Merit Points, even a Supreme Being would work for you.
